title: All 7 test scenarios live in one assert-based binary
evidence: tests.cpp:6-13 — a single main() with 7 assert() calls registered as one ctest target (CMakeLists.txt:15). The spec asks for >=3 tests; coverage is met (test_coverage=1.0) but the first failing assert aborts the rest.
suggestion: Split into discrete named test cases (or a framework like Catch2/GoogleTest) so one failure doesn't mask later scenarios.

title: POST/PUT require 'year' as a present int, stricter than the spec
evidence: main.cpp:36 requires json_object_object_get_ex(o,"year",&y) && type==json_type_int; a request with valid title+author but no year returns 400, though TASK.md only makes title and author required.
suggestion: Default a missing year to 0 (the schema already defaults it) rather than rejecting, to match the 'title and author are required' rule.

title: Single-threaded blocking server
evidence: main.cpp:44 serves one connection at a time in the accept loop; serve_client closes per request.
suggestion: Acceptable for the task; note for throughput-sensitive use.
